tagline: Alliance LOL — we don't take things seriously, we just keep the bubbles up. Three-day truces, overlapping, so nobody's city burns while we're asleep.

landing.title: Your bubble, always up.
landing.sub: LOL keeps overlapping 3-day peace shields on your city — automatically. You play and have fun; we watch the timer.
landing.chooseBody: Two ways in — pick one. Either way, we'll email you a one-time login code.
landing.registerBody: New here? Your email starts your account — we'll help you link your Evony name on the next screen.
landing.loginBody: Already a member? Sign in with the same email we have on file. A code for a new email creates the account too — you'll be asked to link it.
landing.sentBody: We emailed a 6-digit code to {email}. It expires in 10 minutes and works once.
landing.codeSentFor: A fresh code is on its way to {email}.
landing.errNotInvited: That email isn't on the invite list yet — ask the operator to add you.
landing.errCooldown: Easy there — wait a moment before asking for another code.
landing.errRateLimit: Too many codes for this email — try again in a few minutes.
landing.errEmailNotConfigured: Email isn't configured on the server yet — the operator needs to connect a mail provider first.
landing.errSendFailed: We couldn't send that email right now — try again in a minute.
landing.errBadCode: That code doesn't match. Check it and try again.
landing.errNoCode: No active code for that email — request a new one.
landing.errTooMany: Too many wrong codes — request a new one to try again.
landing.f1b: A fresh 3-day truce lands before the last one ends. Zero gaps, zero stress.
landing.f2b: The game spends the gems for each truce — you just approve the plan once.
landing.f3b: One cozy circle, zero drama. We don't do serious — we do shields.

dashboard.noSlots: No slots scheduled yet — add one below.

dashboard.gemAck: I understand each scheduled run spends {gems} gems on a fresh truce.
dashboard.badTime: Times must be valid HH:MM values, e.g. 09:00.

master.title: Operator — master run list

master.empty: No runs recorded yet. Jobs appear here as the scheduler fills due slots.

wizard.intro: Link your Evony account with email and a one-time code. LOL will pop a 3-day bubble on schedule.
wizard.signedOutBody: You need to sign in before linking your account.
wizard.alreadyBody: Your shield is handled — head back to your dashboard.
wizard.step1Body: Enter the account LOL should shield — your sign-in email is already saved.
wizard.startError: Couldn't start the link — check the account ID and try again.
wizard.step2Body: Evony is opening and will email you a login code. This usually takes a few seconds.
wizard.step2Waiting: Waiting for Evony to ask for your email…
wizard.step2Connected: Evony is on the code screen
wizard.step3Title: Enter the code from your email
wizard.step3Body: Check the same email you use for Evony. Type the 6-digit code here and we'll enter it in the game.
wizard.codeError: Couldn't accept that code — try again.
wizard.step4Body: Sending the code into Evony — hang tight.
wizard.step5Body: Three overlapping 3-day bubbles by default (2,500 gems each). Edit days and times below — keep them overlapping so there is no lapse.
wizard.step5Error: Couldn't save your schedule — try again.
wizard.step6Body: Your schedule is saved — taking you to your dashboard.
wizard.failedBody: Something went wrong while linking. Try again.
wizard.expiredBody: This link ran out of time.
wizard.welcomeBody: You're in! Link your Evony account below so the shield lands on the right city. Takes about a minute.

test.title: Test connection
test.body: Runs a quick connectivity check on our servers.
test.runningStatus: Contacting the agent and checking connectivity…
test.ok: Connected. The agent reached the server and responded.
test.okName: Connected. Signed in as {name} — that's you.

info.title: How it works
info.intro: LOL automatic bubble scheduler keeps peace bubbles up for alliance LOL so nobody has to babysit a shield. We don't take things seriously — we just have fun.
info.bubblesBody: An automatic 3-day Truce Agreement on Evony (2,500 gems). The app opens a shield on the right Evony server for you, at the scheduled times, so your city can't be attacked.
info.defaultBody: New members get three overlapping 3-day bubbles: Monday morning 09:00, Wednesday morning 09:00 and Friday evening 18:00 (Evony server time, UTC). Each run lasts 72 hours, so the next one starts before the last one ends — no lapse. You can change the days and times. Each run spends 2,500 gems.
info.i18nBody: We're a far-flung circle, so the whole app switches language. Pick yours in the menu — your schedule is the same everywhere, just in your words.
info.privateBody: No open signup, no passwords. Your email is your login — if you're not on the invite list, the app won't let you in.
